card.name: Punctuation after cross-references and doses
card.fires_on: Periods and commas that close a bracketed section cross-reference, a unit like mm 3 or m 2, or a short instruction in drug label text. The mark comes right before a new clause or section.

modes.label: Period after reference
modes.description: A period right after a bracketed [see ...] section citation or a sentence-ending dosing instruction.
modes.example: Discontinue mometasone furoate nasal spray if such reactions occur [ see Contraindications (4) ]<< .>> 5.4 Immunosuppression

modes.label: Comma after dose or term
modes.description: A comma following a dose with units or a pharmacokinetic term, before a continuing clause or list item.
modes.example: is 600 mg/m 2<< ,>> administered twice daily (maximum total daily dose
